principles: A released characteristic has one stable machine key shared by model PMI, drawing balloon, inspection plan and measurement result.
A drawing balloon is presentation; the acceptance definition remains in the controlled requirement/MBD/product-definition source.
Measured values are data and are evaluated automatically against the current released acceptance definition.
Unknown or open acceptance criteria fail closed.
external_exchange: Use standard inspection/export formats where practical; do not invent a proprietary external exchange format. AP242 with PMI is the preferred neutral product-definition exchange when required.
